blocks.heading: Sales-promotion methods
blocks.text: Sales-promotion methods include temporary discounts, coupons, samples, gifts, competitions and loyalty arrangements. A sample can reduce uncertainty about an unfamiliar low-value product; a coupon encourages a qualifying purchase; a temporary discount changes the immediate price. Assess cost, target behaviour and risks. Repeated discounts can make customers wait for offers, and a free gift has a cost even if its retail value appears attractive. A method should encourage a useful response without misleading terms or promises.

blocks.heading: Putting the idea to work
blocks.text: Eha Snacks considers a small tasting sample against a temporary price discount. A sample addresses uncertainty about taste, while a discount mainly reduces price resistance. Choose the method that matches the barrier and monitor paid conversion rather than count samples as sales.
